LESSON: SIGN READING 4.2.1 VISUAL DISCRIMINATION

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP1
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 4
Topic 4.2: Sign Reading 4.2.1 Visual discrimination
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 5

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sign Reading 4.2.1 Visual discrimination, part of Strand 4 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP1 General.

Key inquiry question: Which animals are kept at home? 2. Which utensils do we use at home?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Sign Reading 4.2.1 Visual discrimination together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
● Love: Selflessness as learner puts the interest of others before their own as they learn together and appreciate other learners’

views while reading about things found at home.

● Responsibility: Accountability as learner identifies ways of taking care of furniture and utensils among other things found at

home.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Disaster Risk Reduction as learner is cautioned against some harmful things found at home.

Link to other Learning Areas:

integrate mathematics as learners are involved in checking what is more and less.

Suggested Learning Resources:

assistive devices fitted with appropriate technology such as hearing aids and amplifiers, books, cards, boards or charts, signed video

clips, relevant digital device, online resources, realia.
